stories.title: UN's top court rules Myanmar committed genocide against Rohingya
stories.summary: The International Court of Justice ruled that Myanmar committed genocide against the Rohingya during its 2017 'clearance operations' - the first time an international court has found a state guilty of genocide. Gambia brought the case on behalf of the roughly 730,000 Rohingya displaced by the crackdown.

stories.title: Israeli military launches rare ground operation in Gaza beyond Yellow Line
stories.summary: The Israeli military said a 'targeted' operation dismantled a 'terror tunnel' west of the Yellow Line marking the more than 60% of Gaza it occupies; Hamas called it a flagrant violation of the October 2025 ceasefire. Violence has continued for 13 months despite the truce.

stories.title: Trump, Putin and Xi issue 'declaration toward peace' after Shenzhen summit
stories.summary: The leaders ended an unprecedented 90-minute trilateral meeting on the sidelines of APEC with a four-point declaration: nuclear war can never be won, the UN should be reformed, refined petroleum supply should grow, and the ICC 'must not abuse its jurisdiction.' None of them spoke afterward, and deep differences over Ukraine, Iran and trade remain.

stories.title: Dozens missing after boat carrying 100 migrants sinks off Senegal
stories.summary: A boat carrying around 100 migrants sank off Senegal's coast with dozens missing; local media report at least four bodies recovered. It comes days after another deadly capsizing in Senegalese waters as Spain declares a migration emergency.

stories.title: Anthropic raises $81.3bn in biggest IPO of all time
stories.summary: Anthropic raised $81.3bn in the largest initial public offering on record, topping SpaceX's $75bn June debut and valuing the five-year-old Claude maker around $1.5tn. It's the first US firm focused exclusively on AI to go public, instantly placing it among the most valuable companies in the world.

stories.title: PHP 8.6 releases today with partial function application and polling API
stories.summary: PHP 8.6 lands today with partial function application, a stopwatch-style Duration class, a native polling API and a new clamp() function, aiming at more expressive code and scalable I/O for event-loop libraries like ReactPHP. A separate critical PHP security release is also due Nov. 19.

stories.title: Grand Theft Auto VI launches to rave reviews after 13-year wait
stories.summary: Grand Theft Auto VI launched at midnight around the world, ending a 13-year wait between instalments and drawing strong early reviews. The release caps one of the longest and most closely watched development cycles in gaming.

stories.title: Ruby2ßhell: pre-authentication RCE disclosed in stock Rails
stories.summary: Researchers disclosed 'Ruby2ßhell' (GHSA-34m4-m9fh-gqp5), a one-byte heap overflow in Ruby's string case-conversion reachable without authentication in common Ruby web frameworks and self-hosted software. Fixes are in Ruby 3.3.14, 3.4.13 and 4.0.10; releases back to 2.4 are affected.

stories.title: Browns' Nov. 29 home game vs. Raiders flexed to Sunday Night Football
stories.summary: Cleveland's Nov. 29 home game against the Raiders has been flexed into Sunday Night Football, a primetime reward for a surprise 6-4 start that has the Browns in the AFC playoff mix.

stories.title: Deshaun Watson keeps winning, but not all Browns fans are ready to forgive
stories.summary: Deshaun Watson has led the Browns to six wins this season, but Cleveland fans remain divided over his troubled past - and his long-term future with the team stays uncertain even as the wins pile up.

stories.title: Winners and losers from the Browns' 27-24 win over the Texans
stories.summary: Quinshon Judkins' second-half touchdown and a defensive turnaround powered Cleveland's comeback from 17-0 down against Houston; cleveland.com's breakdown flags what still needs fixing heading into the bye.

stories.title: Browns bye week awards: best wins, boldest calls and biggest mysteries
stories.summary: At 6-4 and on a much-needed bye, the Browns hand out awards for the best wins, boldest coaching decisions and defensive turnaround behind the surprise season - plus the key concerns heading into the final stretch.

stories.title: Buckeyes move up six spots to No. 14 in CFP rankings ahead of Nebraska trip
stories.summary: Ohio State jumped from 20th to 14th in the College Football Playoff rankings after five teams above it lost, putting the Buckeyes back on the at-large bubble. They still need to climb three more spots, so a 2-0 finish - starting Saturday at Nebraska - is non-negotiable.

stories.title: Hamilton: No trust problem with Ferrari team
stories.summary: Lewis Hamilton says there are no trust issues at Ferrari and the team is 'super united,' despite two recent incidents in which he ignored a team call to pit for fresh tyres. The comments come as F1 heads toward the Las Vegas Grand Prix weekend.

stories.title: 13-year-old driver dies after northeast Columbus crash
stories.summary: Columbus police say 13-year-old Bobby Summerall III has died from injuries suffered when the Hyundai Sonata he was driving struck a tree on Joyce Avenue early Tuesday. Two juveniles reportedly fled the scene, and the Accident Investigation Unit probe continues.

stories.title: Russo to prioritize voter outreach as Ohio's next secretary of state
stories.summary: Columbus-area Democrat Allison Russo, Ohio's incoming secretary of state, says voter outreach will be a top priority for the office once she takes over in January.

stories.title: What Gov.-elect Amy Acton plans to change for rural Ohioans
stories.summary: Gov.-elect Amy Acton lays out what she plans to change for rural Ohioans in a new NBC4 interview - the latest transition step ahead of her Jan. 11 inauguration.
